scientific_integrity: Uses classical circumscribed curvature asymptotics and the Rényi capacity–radius reduction. Taylor expansion with explicit angular moments proves the sixth-order gap; finite quadrature is corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-density leading expected errors only. The sixth-order gap is for the specified planar support-function family near a disk, not a universal or finite-sample claim.
title: A sixth-order gap in the equal-weight bound for circumscribed random polytopes
